kiln.source:
// Written for what a state carries inside it: descriptions under a header,
// internal transitions drawn as loops inside their states, and hierarchy
// crossings into composites whose headers wall their top faces.
chart kiln "pottery kiln controller" {
  @doc = "ramps, soaks and cools a firing schedule",

  state Idle "door closed, elements off",
  state Loading "door open",
  state Firing "schedule running" {
    submachine heat "element control" {
      state Ramping "climbing at the segment rate",
      state Soaking "holding at the segment peak",
      state Cooling "controlled descent",
      trans * -> Ramping,
      trans Ramping -> Soaking "peak reached",
      trans Soaking -> Ramping "next segment",
      trans Soaking -> Cooling "last segment done",
      trans internal Ramping -> Ramping "pid tick",
      trans internal Soaking -> Soaking "pid tick",
    },
    submachine watch "thermocouple watch" {
      state Reading,
      state Suspect "two readings disagree",
      trans * -> Reading,
      trans Reading -> Suspect "drift",
      trans Suspect -> Reading "agree",
      trans internal Reading -> Reading "sample",
    },
  },
  state Fault "latched until acknowledged" {
    state Overtemp,
    state Sensor,
    trans * -> Overtemp,
  },
  state Done "cooled below handling temperature",

  trans * -> Idle,
  trans Idle -> Loading "door opened",
  trans Loading -> Idle "door closed",
  trans Idle -> Firing "start",
  trans internal Idle -> Idle "display refresh",
  trans Idle -> Idle "self test",
  trans internal Firing -> Firing "log segment",
  trans Firing -> Done "cooled",
  trans Firing:watch/Suspect -> Fault/Sensor "sensor lost",
  trans Firing:heat/Ramping -> Fault/Overtemp "runaway",
  trans internal Fault -> Fault/Sensor "retest",
  trans Fault -> Idle "acknowledged",
  trans Done -> Idle "unloaded",
}
